selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL installed and running on all 3 nodes
selected_evidence.summary: postgresql-9.5 installed and pg_lsclusters/systemctl show 'online' on node1, node2, node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 configured as primary with replication settings
selected_evidence.summary: postgresql.conf shows wal_level=hot_standby, listen_addresses='*'; pg_hba.conf has replication entries for node2/node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as streaming standbys from node1
selected_evidence.summary: pg_basebackup completed from node1; recovery.conf set standby_mode=on; pg_lsclusters shows 'online,recovery' on both

selected_evidence.requirement: Primary and standby streaming replication link is active
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 and node3 in 'streaming' state; pg_is_in_recovery()=t on both standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Writes on primary are visible on both standbys; standbys are read-only
selected_evidence.summary: Rows inserted on node1 (repl_test) appear identically on node2 and node3; INSERT attempts on both standbys fail with 'cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction'

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 74fd91b6...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to f056935d...; postgresql online,recovery with data intact (count=2) and streaming resumed on node1

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d08fb446...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to 691591ce...; postgresql online,recovery with data intact (count=2); node1 confirms both standbys streaming before proceeding to primary restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and quorum
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dca72801...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to 85cd9812...; postgresql back online as primary; pg_stat_replication shows both node2 and node3 reconnected streaming; new INSERT on primary verified present on both standbys, confirming full recovery of cluster and replication

commands.command:
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE TABLE repl_test (id serial primary key, note text, created_at timestamptz default now());"
sudo -u postgres psql -c "INSERT INTO repl_test (note) VALUES ('hello from primary'), ('streaming replication check');"
sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT * FROM repl_test;"
sleep 1; sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT * FROM repl_test;"; sudo -u postgres psql -c "INSERT INTO repl_test (note) VALUES ('should fail');" 2>&1
